headline: Getty Images Files for Bankruptcy After Merger Collapse and AI Competition
summary: Getty Images has filed for bankruptcy and is advancing a restructuring plan after its planned merger with Shutterstock collapsed under heavy debt and AI competition.
why: Bankruptcy filings by established content providers highlight the disruption traditional media business models face from generative artificial intelligence and high debt loads.

impacts.name: Getty Images
impacts.why: Bankruptcy filings and restructuring plans severely impair equity value and highlight intense competitive pressures.
